verdict.rationale: Mistral documents an Agents API whose agents 'autonomously execute tasks' with tools, state persistence and multi-agent handoffs for 'workflow automation' [mistral-docs-21, mistral-docs-20]. Batch processing [mistral-docs-7] adds asynchronous background execution of large workloads. However, nothing shows a way to set up standing automations that run on their own in the background; agents appear to be invoked per API request, and orchestration is left to the developer. Missing for 10: scheduled/cron or event-triggered automations, managed background execution of agent workflows, monitoring of running automations, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
